summary.dms_tool_issues: All DMS conversion attempts failed due to metadata model creation or conversion timeouts. This appears to be a systematic DMS service issue rather than SQL syntax problems.
summary.manual_conversion_approach: Applied PostgreSQL best practices for manual conversion: GETDATE() to NOW(), SCOPE_IDENTITY() to RETURNING clause, BEGIN TRANSACTION to BEGIN, DECLARE variables to CTEs or subqueries
summary.compatibility_notes: Most SQL Server constructs used in this application are compatible with PostgreSQL: window functions, CTEs, CASE expressions, ROUND function, JOIN operations, and named parameters (via Npgsql driver)
critical_changes: SCOPE_IDENTITY() replaced with RETURNING clause in INSERT statements
GETDATE() replaced with NOW() for current timestamp
Transaction syntax adjusted from BEGIN TRANSACTION to BEGIN
Variable declarations removed and converted to CTEs or subqueries
summary.schema_changes: No schema object name changes required. Tables remain: Products, ProductHistory, ProductStats. Default schema changed from dbo to public (PostgreSQL default).
